meta.name: Scripps Sports Network
meta.description:
Scripps Sports is your home for live games and original programming that bring fans closer to the action, the athletes, and the communities they love.

Shows: Cold as Balls, WNBA Basketball, The Makeshift Project: She's The Highest Paid Athlete?!, Scripps National Spelling Bee Semi-Finals, Scripps National Spelling Bee Finals
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Tubi
